analysis_type: Post-hoc comparison of existing external candidate stress outputs; no refitting or new experiment

comparison_rule.driver: Use scripts/external_coverage.py as the single reusable driver and preserve both wrapper-specific native-model boundaries
comparison_rule.metrics: Retain dataset-specific point counts, covered points, continuous safe folds, bound widths, independent-box status and candidate/baseline RMSE per fold
comparison_rule.totals: Sums are descriptive of these 115 points only and are not a universal external success rate or probability coverage
comparison_rule.evidence_levels: Filip and MGH17 are candidate approximation stress tests, not native-model validation, physical endogeneity or probability calibration
